## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle anonymous Chinese translation of a discourse on the five merit-rewards (long life, beauty, strength, peace, eloquence) that come from giving food. The Chinese parallel is T125[32.11].

**Abstract**

The Eastern Jìn (317–420) ascription is a catalog-tradition assignment. The defensible bracket is recorded in the frontmatter. The Indic source is presumed lost.
